thread: Ravi: FYI starter app crashes in --json-mode when the tool returns an array. Lina: Which SDK? Ravi: TS node starter. Error: `SchemaError expected object got array`. QA-bot: CI build 4610 failed samplekit-jsonmode. Lina: We used to auto-unwrap single-element arrays in Node helper; TS helper lost parity. Proposal: add normalizeToolOutput(raw,schema,mode) to TS SDK to unwrap single-item arrays, parse double-encoded strings, fallback if mismatch. Ravi: Make it opt-in via jsonMode: 'strict'|'lenient' and log telemetry tool_normalized=true/false. Docsy: I'll add a short note in onboarding docs "Structured output quirks" and warn about double-encode retries. QA-bot: queued build 4611 on PR. Lina: PR link https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/299 (WIP). Ravi: adding unit tests for unwrap, double-encode, and no-op. Thanks :thumbsup:
